_comment: Durable, git-tracked changelog of Brubru knowledge-base activity. Powers the 'What's new' feed in MEUB > Brubru Databases > Knowledge Guides. Append via scripts/kb_changelog.py (never hand-edit unless fixing). Newest entries FIRST. action: 'added' | 'updated' | 'canon' | 'deep_dive'.

entries.title: CBAM
entries.summary: QUICK FACTS precision: CBAM is not a tax; six covered sectors locked; EUR 45-50bn = import value not revenue

entries.title: EU Sanctions Implementation Framework
entries.summary: LATEST: Libya regime update — Council Reg 2026/1332 + CFSP Dec 2026/1334 (12 June, OJ L)

entries.title: New Genomic Techniques (NGT)
entries.summary: LATEST: EP final plenary vote scheduled Wed 17 June 2026

entries.title: AI Act Simplification Omnibus
entries.summary: LATEST: EP plenary first-reading vote scheduled Tue 16 June 2026 (high-risk delay + AI-nudifier ban)

entries.title: End-of-Life Vehicles (ELV) Regulation
entries.summary: New guide: circularity requirements for vehicle design + ELV management (2023/0284(COD)); EP final plenary vote scheduled Thu 18 June 2026

entries.title: Digital Networks Act
entries.summary: Corrected opinion rapporteurs (IMCO=Yon-Courtin 8 May, LIBE=Vasconcelos); removed false 5 May draft-report claim (OEIL: no report tabled, awaiting committee decision); added 28 Jan Virkkunen structured dialogue + Council Working Party examination

entries.title: Eurodac and the New Pact
entries.summary: Recast Eurodac now applying from 12 June 2026: facial images + fingerprints, age threshold lowered to 6, SIS/VIS/ETIAS interoperability

entries.title: EU Pact on Migration and Asylum
entries.summary: Pact enters into application 12 June 2026: mandatory screening (7d/3d), border procedures, needs-based solidarity mechanism, EU-wide reception standards, Eurodac live

entries.title: Digital Omnibus Package
entries.summary: EDPB position to LIBE (8 Jun): supports simplification but opposes personal-data definition change; LIBE postponed AI Act Joint Working Group + AI Omnibus trilogue report-back (rapporteur absent)

entries.title: GDPR / Data Protection
entries.summary: EDPB Chair Anu Talus presented the 2025 Annual Report to LIBE (8 Jun): EUR 1.1bn DPA fines, 572 cross-border decisions, DMA/DSA/AI Act-GDPR joint guidance, Helsinki Statement, opposes Digital Omnibus personal-data redefinition

entries.title: EU Trade Policy
entries.summary: EU-Korea Digital Trade Agreement signed at 11th Summit (10 Jun 2026): e-contracts/e-signatures, cross-border data flows, no forced source-code transfer; EU's 2nd standalone DTA, ratification pending

entries.title: EU Defence Procurement
entries.summary: Omnibus V defence simplification package provisional agreement (8 Jun 2026): permit acceleration 2025/0172, transfers+procurement 2025/0177, investments 2025/0176

entries.title: AI Act
entries.summary: Code of Practice on marking & labelling AI-generated content (Art. 50 transparency, voluntary, applies 2 Aug 2026) + 8th AI Board meeting

entries.title: EU Sanctions Implementation Framework
entries.summary: 21st Russia sanctions package proposed 9 Jun 2026 (shadow fleet +30 vessels, first-time targeting of assisting vessels + crypto + fishing industry + entry ban on Russia-side fighters); not yet adopted

entries.title: Digital Markets Act
entries.summary: Commission imposed first-ever DMA Article 24 interim measures on Meta (9 Jun 2026): restore free WhatsApp access for rival AI assistants within 5 working days, in force until June 2029

entries.title: European Biotech Act
entries.summary: Added verified joint SANT-ITRE committee (Rule 58), rapporteurs Andriukaitis (S&D) and Beke (EPP), 13 shadows, ENVI/JURI opinions, the two precursor INI reports and the 19 March 2026 joint-committee presentation; replaced the stale 'no rapporteur appointed' status block.

entries.title: EU Health Security Framework (Health Union)
entries.summary: New guide: Reg 2022/2371 cross-border health threats + reinforced ECDC (2022/2370) + EMA (2022/123) + HERA + EWRS + Health Security Committee

entries.title: Union Customs Code Reform
entries.summary: Added the temporary EUR 3 customs duty on low-value imported parcels (Implementing Reg 2026/1200), bridging to the full reform's de minimis abolition.

entries.title: EU Fisheries Policy
entries.summary: Added the Commission's sustainable-fishing orientations for 2027 and the European Ocean Pact one-year review.

entries.title: EU Customs Reform
entries.summary: Added the temporary EUR 3 customs duty on low-value imported parcels (distance sales up to EUR 150), Implementing Reg 2026/1200.

entries.title: EFPIA pharma canon: 10 EU pharma laws
entries.summary: Ten core EU pharmaceutical laws shipped end to end: 10 Chat guides, 60 deep-dive pages (6 languages), 10 EU Law Comply clusters.

entries.title: Three framework directives canon
entries.summary: EECC, Solvency II and MiFID II shipped: 3 Chat guides, 18 deep-dive pages with transposition maps, 3 EU Law Comply clusters.

entries.title: European Semester
entries.summary: Added the 2026 Spring Package (country-specific recommendations, reformed Stability and Growth Pact dimension).
